description: This Java source file defines the ConnectionTimeoutException class, a custom runtime exception used in the context of connectivity operations, specifically for timeout errors on connection operations within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes constructors, static factory methods, and a builder for creating instances with relevant details.
